About the Role

As a Senior Risk Analyst for Payment Gateway, you’ll play a key role in identifying potential fraud risks and developing effective mitigation strategies as our business continues to grow. You’ll work with data to spot patterns, build and refine risk rules, and recommend action plans that help keep our risk metrics on target while supporting healthy business expansion.

What You Will Do

• Key fraud analyst to the business teams for the payment gateway business line
• Conducting deep dives, sampling and analysis on risk related issues
• Build comprehensive risk metrics monitoring and closely monitor of risk metrics, underlying drivers - and the overall business metrics
• Assess, validate and optimize risk rules and requirements - to ensure best outcome of risk/reward and to meet stated risk target metrics
• Develop risk platform solutions that will balance the various requirements from the product lines but yet maintain a holistic view of the customer experience
• Proactively builds trust-based relationships with stakeholders while maintaining the ability to remain objective

What You Will Need

• 3+ years of related payment risk experience, preferably on the payment gateway and switcher covering payment gateway process, credit card payment risk and e-money payment risk is a plus
• Able to identify problem, assess issues and recommend solutions both at the strategic and tactical levels - balancing the business vision and practical implementation considerations
• Intermediate proficiency in SQL and cloud-based data platform such as Google BigQuery or MaxCompute
• Hands-on experience in data processing and business intelligence tools (ie. Google Sheets/Excel, Quick BI, Google Looker, Metabase, etc) for trend analysis and insight generation to support business decision-making.
• Strong understanding of risk solutions, advanced fraud detection solutions, product implementation - on the business side
• Experience developing risk policy with risk-based approach
• Experience of working with operations, software engineering, business, product, compliance, and data functions
• Ability to create prioritisation and track progress

About the Team

You’ll join the Merchant Payment Risk team—an energetic group that constantly balances smart risk-taking with sustainable growth (all while keeping a surprisingly good sense of humor). We challenge assumptions, ask tough questions, and solve problems to drive real impact. If you enjoy sharp discussions, thoughtful debates, and the occasional “aha!” moment, you’ll feel right at home. We’re genuinely excited about the possibility of having you on board.

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

wo-jpfa-JR5295.d:
Hand Add & Hammer Mill Operator

Location: Singkawang, West Kalimantan
Company: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Hammer Mill Operations

• Inspect hammer mill equipment, including hammers, hammer shafts, screens, and magnets, to ensure optimal machine performance.
• Operate and monitor hammer mill systems to achieve production targets and maintain grinding efficiency.
• Clean magnet pipes on PM4 and PM5 elevators to ensure smooth material flow and prevent metal contamination.
• Monitor and inspect corn and feed meal particle size produced by Hammer Mill 1 and Hammer Mill 2 to ensure compliance with product specifications.
• Clean hammer mill dust filters regularly to maintain efficient operation and support feed quality.
• Ensure all hammer mill equipment is maintained in good operating condition through routine inspections and autonomous maintenance activities.

Feed Additive (Hand Add) Operations

• Receive and hand over feed additives accurately with the batching/formulation team to ensure inventory accuracy and traceability.
• Add feed additives into Hand Add System 1 (HI-1) according to formulation requirements.
• Add feed additives into Hand Add System 2 (HI-2) according to production recipes and specifications.
• Verify feed additive usage to ensure correct dosing and compliance with approved formulations.
• Maintain dosing weighers in a clean and proper condition to support accurate ingredient weighing.
• Monitor vitamin consumption and reconcile usage records to ensure inventory accuracy.

Quality Control & Process Monitoring

• Inspect mixer conditions and identify any leakage to prevent product contamination and quality issues.
• Clean palm olein filters regularly to ensure smooth spraying operations.
• Monitor palm olein spraying systems to verify even distribution throughout the feed product.
• Clean filters on Degussa equipment to maintain proper filtration performance.
• Ensure all production activities comply with feed quality standards and manufacturing requirements.
• Take corrective action and report abnormalities whenever quality deviations are identified.

Reporting & Documentation

• Prepare daily Hammer Mill and Hand Add operation reports.
• Prepare shift handover reports for Hand Add 1 and Hand Add 2 activities.
• Prepare vitamin consumption and inventory usage reports.
• Prepare autonomous maintenance reports for equipment under the operator’s responsibility.
• Prepare particle size inspection reports for feed meal produced by Hammer Mill 1 and Hammer Mill 2.
• Maintain accurate and timely operational records to support production analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.

Housekeeping, Safety & Compliance

• Maintain cleanliness of machines, equipment, and work areas to support safe and efficient operations.
• Wear and properly use all required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while performing duties.
• Follow Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) procedures, Company policies, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Report unsafe conditions, equipment abnormalities, and production deviations to the supervisor.
• Support continuous improvement programs related to productivity, quality, and workplace safety.

Hand Add & Hammer Mill Operator

Lokasi: Singkawang, Kalimantan Barat
Perusahaan: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk

Deskripsi Pekerjaan (Job Description)

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Operasional Hammer Mill

• Melakukan pemeriksaan kondisi mesin hammer mill, termasuk pisau, as pisau, screen, dan magnet untuk memastikan mesin beroperasi secara optimal.
• Mengoperasikan dan memantau mesin hammer mill agar target produksi dan efisiensi grinding dapat tercapai.
• Membersihkan pipa magnet pada elevator PM4 dan PM5 untuk menjaga kelancaran aliran bahan baku serta mencegah kontaminasi logam.
• Melakukan pemeriksaan ukuran partikel (particle size) jagung hasil grinding Hammer Mill 1 dan tepung hasil grinding Hammer Mill 2 agar sesuai dengan standar yang ditetapkan.
• Melakukan pembersihan dust filter hammer mill secara berkala guna menjaga kelancaran proses dan kualitas produk.
• Menjaga kondisi mesin hammer mill tetap optimal melalui inspeksi rutin dan kegiatan perawatan mandiri (autonomous maintenance).

Operasional Feed Additive (Hand Add)

• Melaksanakan serah terima feed additive dengan bagian peracikan (batching) secara akurat untuk memastikan kesesuaian jumlah dan jenis bahan.
• Memasukkan feed additive ke sistem Hand Add 1 (HI-1) sesuai formula yang telah ditetapkan.
• Memasukkan feed additive ke sistem Hand Add 2 (HI-2) sesuai resep dan kebutuhan produksi.
• Melakukan verifikasi penggunaan feed additive untuk memastikan ketepatan dosis dan kesesuaian dengan formulasi.
• Menjaga kebersihan dosing weigher agar proses penimbangan bahan berjalan akurat dan higienis.
• Memantau pemakaian vitamin dan feed additive serta memastikan pencatatan penggunaan dilakukan dengan benar.

Pengendalian Mutu dan Monitoring Proses

• Melakukan pemeriksaan kondisi mixer dan mendeteksi kebocoran yang dapat memengaruhi kualitas produk.
• Membersihkan filter palm olein secara berkala untuk memastikan proses penyemprotan berjalan lancar.
• Melakukan pengecekan distribusi spray palm olein agar penyebarannya merata pada produk pakan.
• Membersihkan filter pada mesin Degussa untuk menjaga efektivitas proses filtrasi.
• Memastikan seluruh aktivitas produksi memenuhi standar mutu dan spesifikasi pakan ternak yang berlaku.
• Mengidentifikasi dan melaporkan penyimpangan kualitas serta melakukan tindakan korektif sesuai prosedur.

Pelaporan dan Dokumentasi

• Membuat laporan harian operasional Hammer Mill dan Hand Add.
• Membuat laporan serah terima Hand Add 1 dan Hand Add 2 antar shift.
• Membuat laporan pemakaian vitamin dan feed additive untuk memantau penggunaan dan persediaan.
• Membuat laporan perawatan mandiri operator terhadap peralatan yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya.
• Membuat laporan hasil pemeriksaan particle size tepung dari Hammer Mill 1 dan Hammer Mill 2.
• Memastikan seluruh data operasional dicatat secara akurat dan tepat waktu sebagai bahan evaluasi dan analisis.

Housekeeping, K3, dan Kepatuhan

• Menjaga kebersihan mesin, peralatan, dan area kerja guna mendukung lingkungan kerja yang aman dan produktif.
• Menggunakan Alat Pelindung Diri (APD) sesuai ketentuan selama bekerja.
• Mematuhi seluruh prosedur Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3), SOP, dan kebijakan perusahaan.
• Melaporkan kondisi tidak aman, kerusakan peralatan, atau penyimpangan proses kepada atasan.
• Mendukung program peningkatan berkelanjutan terkait produktivitas, kualitas, dan keselamatan kerja.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

Requirements

• Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology or Computer Engineering, or related field.
• Minimum 1 year of experience as an Functional Business Analyst, preferably in Oracle ERP Manufacturing modules.
• Proven experience in system configuration, testing, and functional support.
• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills and understanding of manufacturing processes and how they integrate with Oracle ERP.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with business users and technical teams to deliver seamless solutions.
• Experience in requirements gathering, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, solution design and project management skills.

Job Description

• Hands-on in setup configuration, documentation, testing, and support, with the ability to recommend best practice for process improvements, change requests, or new implementations.
• Partner with business users/stakeholders in manufacturing to identify process issues and opportunities.
• Analyzing business requirements, testing, and solution design with stakeholders.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders (with their needs) and technical teams to deliver integrated solutions.

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
